positions.title: Sr, Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, Architected, Built and impleted the Vendor-Distributor-Allowance system for Operator rebates. The system allows the company to provide a state of the art solution to any sales and distributor systems for distributor or operator rebate management.

Designed, Architected and Built the GDSN system. Indepth knowledge of how GDSN works, a key architect in making ITrade one of the DataPools in the north american markets.

Designed, Architected and Built the DMS (Data Management System) , that offers indepth intelligence to the GDSN community with ITN by linking and compairing the supplier and buyer catalogs.
